messages.text: Tombstone Familie Laurenz is in this build, set as you left it in the 3D studio. Every build from here uses this exact model throughout the site.
A memorial page for rugged coins: the trench graveyard, every dead token gets a stone, with a short story and a live list of the newest rugs.
The whole page did not fit in one reply, so it was built in 3 sections shared by Mind A and Mind B.
Page 1 is ready. Open Static to try it.
Its changes did not match the page. Mark the part to change with +, or say "rebuild" to have it write the whole page new. Nothing changed, and the last page is safe.
